valuation_refresh.market_data_note: prices_as_of is the latest market close available from yfinance/local cache, not calendar today. When the market has not yet published a close for the current session (or over a weekend), NAV will match the prior session and unchanged NAV vs the last refresh is expected.
valuation_refresh.disclaimer: Valuation refresh only — updates NAV and mark-to-market prices against existing share counts. Does NOT re-run review_cycle, change holdings, re-evaluate eligibility, record Portfolio B picks, or archive a monthly cycle. Full portfolio decisions happen on the monthly review (7th of each month) via run_monthly_review.py.
does: Recompute NAV from existing share counts × latest market prices
Update per-holding price, market_value, and weight in the export
does_not: Record or alter Portfolio B decisions
Archive a monthly cycle or write dashboard/cycle reports
